description: A thin real-size wisp of steam rising 0.2-0.5 m/s from a marked source (a hot drink, a vent, an exhaust), fading out within 10-20 cm. Stateless (the wisp's noise is advected by a keyed mapping, so any frame renders anywhere). Needs a source: a marker naming steam, a vent or a spout, or an emissive / exhaust detail; without one it rises from the subject's top.

windCalibration.unit: wisp lean m/s per wind m/s
